source.quote: a new generation of visual language models for image and video understanding

GLM-4V, a 13-billion-parameter bilingual visual language model to explore the image understanding
capabilities in both English and Chinese.

CogVLM2            19B        EVA-CLIP-E          LLaMA3-8B       Conv + SwiGLU
   GLM-4V-9B           13B        EVA-CLIP-E            GLM4-9B       Conv + SwiGLU
 CogVLM2-Video         12B        EVA-CLIP-E          LLaMA3-8B       Conv + SwiGLU

architecture.value: ViT (EVA-CLIP-E) encoder, Conv+SwiGLU adapter, LLM backbone (LLaMA3-8B or GLM4-9B); CogVLM2 uses visual expert in attention and FFN; GLM-4V uses image-language co-training; CogVLM2 up to 1344×1344, GLM-4V 1120×1120

source.quote:
The CogVLM family of models comprises four key components: a Vision Transformer (ViT [3])
encoder, an adapter, a language model, and an optional visual expert module.

trainingData.value: Progressive pre-training data construction (LAION-2B and further image-text, OCR, grounding, caption, VQA, alignment and preference corpora); video TQA with automated temporal grounding

source.quote:
Utilizing these two techniques, the construction of pre-training data for CogVLM family is progressive
and incremental.

notes: Technical report on CogVLM2 family capability, not a system card. No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability section or numeric safety evals.
